Introduction
This script is dedicated to visualizing preprocessed data from **1DP_01_mg_cells_raw_data_to_seurat_merged_integrated_UMAP.Rmd**. The processed data are represented using **UMAP plots, dot plots, and stacked plots** to illustrate clustering, marker expression, and population distributions. These visualizations provide insights into cell-type composition and gene expression patterns across different isolation protocols.


```{r Load packages and lists,  eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressMessages(library("Matrix"))
suppressMessages(library("RColorBrewer"))
suppressMessages(library("ggplot2"))
suppressMessages(library("Seurat"))
suppressMessages(library("sctransform"))
suppressMessages(library("scales"))
suppressMessages(library("dplyr"))
suppressMessages(library("SeuratWrappers"))
suppressMessages(library("reshape2"))
suppressMessages(library("ComplexHeatmap"))
suppressMessages(library("gridExtra"))
suppressMessages(library("magrittr"))
suppressMessages(library("patchwork"))
suppressMessages(library("ggpubr"))
plots <- list()
col_list <- list()
orders <- list()
source("0F_general_functions.R", local = F, echo = F, print.eval = F)
source("0F_colours_orders.R", local = F, echo = F, print.eval = F)
#Read table with gene symbols end IDs
gene_symbol <- read.table("data/Smartseq3xpress.gene_names.txt", header = TRUE)
```

UMAP visualisation - extension - clusters in individual conditions 
```{r}
#Load seurat
seurat_mg <- readRDS("ws/1DP_01_seurat_merged_integrated_UMAP_mg_cells.rds")
# 1. Define the Dictionary (Condition Name = Exclusion String)
filter_dict <- c(
  "LiveCells"   = "LiveNuclei + FixedNuclei",
  "LiveNuclei"  = "LiveCells + FixedNuclei",
  "FixedNuclei" = "LiveCells + LiveNuclei"
)

# 2. Loop through the dictionary keys
for (cond in names(filter_dict)) {
  
  # Get the exclusion value from our dictionary
  exclude_val <- filter_dict[cond]
  
  # Subset the cells safely using the metadata index
  cells_to_keep <- seurat_mg@meta.data[[cond]] != exclude_val
  seurat_filtered <- subset(seurat_mg, cells = colnames(seurat_mg)[cells_to_keep])
  
  # Construct keys for storage and colors
  plot_key <- paste0("UMAP_mg_abbr_", cond)
  color_key <- paste0("UMAP", cond)
  
  # 3. Create the Plot
  plots[[plot_key]] <- DimPlot(
    seurat_filtered,
    reduction = "umap.cca_rm",
    group.by = "Cell_types_mg_abbr",
    pt.size = 0.1,
    cols = col_list[["UMAP_mg"]]
  ) + 
    ggtitle(cond) + 
    theme_umap + 
    remove_grid + 
    remove_axes +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1)))

  # Display in the notebook
  print(plots[[plot_key]])
}
```

```{r}
# Define the layout: three plots in a single row
layout_row <- "ABC"

# Combine the three specific plots
plots[["final_row"]] <- plots[["UMAP_mg_abbr_LiveCells"]] + 
                        plots[["UMAP_mg_abbr_LiveNuclei"]] + 
                        plots[["UMAP_mg_abbr_FixedNuclei"]] +
  plot_layout(
    design = layout_row, 
    widths = c(1.5, 1.5, 1.5),
    guides = "collect"  # This is the magic line that merges the legends
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = list(c('A', '', '')),
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "plain")
    )
  ) & 
  theme(legend.position = "right") # Moves the shared legend to the right side

# Display the final combined visualization
plots[["final_row"]]
```

```{r RNA normalization,  eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(seurat_mg) <- "RNA" 
seurat_mg <- JoinLayers(seurat_mg, assay = "RNA")
all.genes.RNA <- rownames(seurat_mg)
seurat_mg <- NormalizeData(seurat_mg, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

```

```{r Dot plot with feature test,  eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(seurat_mg) <- "RNA"
Idents(seurat_mg) <- "Cell_types_mg_abbr"


plots[["dot_plot_mg"]] <- DotPlot(
  seurat_mg, 
  features = Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(markers_mg), 
 dot.min = 0.20 
) + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ENSEMBL_to_Symbol(Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(markers_mg))) + 
  theme_mk + 
  remove_grid +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 290, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 6, face = "italic"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),                                
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),                               
    legend.position = "bottom",                                    
    plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),                                  
  legend.margin = margin(b = -5, l = -3),
  legend.box.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),
  legend.box.just = "left"
    ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    name = "Scaled average \ngene expression",  
    colors = c("#E8ECEF","#9ABDDC", "#3A0956")             
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Pergentage \nof cells (%)",
    range = c(0.5, 2)              # Set the range for dot sizes; adjust as needed
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_colorbar(title.position = "left"), # Adjust legend color bar position if needed
    size = guide_legend(title.position = "left")     # Adjust size legend position if needed
  )
  

plots[["dot_plot_mg"]]
```

#Stacked bar_plots with relative proportion of cells in clusters
```{r Data frame with percentages for clusters per condition,  eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
metadata_df <- read.csv("ws/1DP_01_mg_seurat_metadata.csv")
# Calculate total counts per condition
total_counts_per_condition <- metadata_df %>%
  group_by(Cond_publication) %>%
  tally(name = "total_cells")

# Calculate counts per cluster per condition
cluster_counts <- metadata_df %>%
  group_by(Cond_publication, Cell_types_mg_abbr) %>%
  tally(name = "cluster_count")

# Join the total counts with cluster counts
perc_clust_per_condition <- cluster_counts %>%
  left_join(total_counts_per_condition, by = "Cond_publication") %>%
  mutate(percent = (cluster_count / total_cells) * 100) %>%
  select(Cond_publication, Cell_types_mg_abbr, percent)

# View the resulting data frame
print(perc_clust_per_condition)

rm(total_counts_per_condition, cluster_counts)

#change order of cell types - inverted
perc_clust_per_condition$Cell_types_mg_abbr <- factor(perc_clust_per_condition$Cell_types_mg_abbr, levels = orders[["Cell_types_mg_abbr_invert"]])
perc_clust_per_condition$Cell_types_mg_abbr %>% table()

#group Sham together and MCAO 
perc_clust_per_condition$Cond_publication <- factor(perc_clust_per_condition$Cond_publication, levels = orders[["Cond_publication"]])



# Group microglia cluster into one - better for visualisation 
perc_clust_per_condition %<>% mutate("Cond_SHAMvsMCAO" = factor(case_when(
   Cond_publication == "LiveCells_Sham" ~ "Sham",
   Cond_publication == "LiveNuclei_Sham"~ "Sham",
   Cond_publication == "FixedNuclei_Sham" ~ "Sham",
   Cond_publication ==  "LiveCells_MCAO"~ "MCAO",
   Cond_publication == "LiveNuclei_MCAO" ~ "MCAO",
   Cond_publication == "FixedNuclei_MCAO" ~ "MCAO"
)))

#group SHAM or MCAO
perc_clust_per_condition$Cond_SHAMvsMCAO <- factor(perc_clust_per_condition$Cond_SHAMvsMCAO, levels = orders[["Cond_SHAMvsMCAO"]])


perc_clust_per_condition %<>% mutate("Cond_appr" = factor(case_when(
   Cond_publication == "LiveCells_Sham" ~ "LiveCells",
  Cond_publication == "LiveNuclei_Sham"~ "LiveNuclei",
  Cond_publication == "FixedNuclei_Sham" ~ "FixedNuclei",
  Cond_publication ==  "LiveCells_MCAO"~ "LiveCells",
  Cond_publication == "LiveNuclei_MCAO" ~ "LiveNuclei",
  Cond_publication == "FixedNuclei_MCAO" ~ "FixedNuclei"
)))
```

```{r Stacked bar plot - condition vs percentage of cells,  eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plots[["stacked_bar_mg"]] <- ggplot(perc_clust_per_condition, aes(x = Cond_appr, y = percent, fill = Cell_types_mg_abbr)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "#2d1800", size = 0.3 ) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_list[["UMAP_mg"]]) +  
  labs(x = "Conditions", y = "Relative proportion of cells (%)", fill = "Cell \ntypes") +
 theme_mk +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),               # Remove extra padding
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20))+  # Set y-axis breaks at 20-unit intervals
  facet_grid(. ~ Cond_SHAMvsMCAO)+
  remove_grid +
   theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6),        # Customize strip text size
    strip.background = element_blank(),         # Remove the facet strip background
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.margin = margin(t = -7.5),
    plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 310, vjust = +0.1, hjust = +0.2),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
    legend.text = element_text(margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 1, l = 1)),
    legend.title = element_text(margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 6, l = 1))
    )  


plots[["stacked_bar_mg"]]
```

#ARM, IRM expression from Frigerio2019
```{r}
ARM_up <-  Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(c("Apoe", "Cst7", "Lpl", "Clec7a", "Lyz2", "Ccl3", "Lgals3bp", "Cd63", "H2-D1", "Ctsb"))
seurat_mg <- AddModuleScore(seurat_mg, features = list(ARM_up), assay = "RNA", name = "ARM_up_")

ARM_down <-  Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(c("Selplg", "Cd164", "P2ry12", "Crybb1", "Tmem119", "Stab1", "Ivns1abp", "Ecscr", "P2ry13", "Slc2a5"))
seurat_mg <- AddModuleScore(seurat_mg, features = list(ARM_down), assay = "RNA", name = "ARM_down_")

IRM_up <-  Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(c("Ifit3", "Ifitm3", "Rtp4", "Irf7", "Oasl2", "Ifi204",  "Usp18", "Ifi209", "Ifi27l2a", "Oas1a"))
seurat_mg <- AddModuleScore(seurat_mg, features = list(IRM_up), assay = "RNA", name = "IRM_up_")

CPM_up <-  Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(c("Mcm5", "Mcm2", "Mcm6", "Lig1", "Stmn1", "Tipin", "Hmgb2", "Dnmt1", "Cbx5", "Mcm7"))
seurat_mg <- AddModuleScore(seurat_mg, features = list(CPM_up), assay = "RNA", name = "CPM_up_")
```

```{r Feature plots from Frigerio,  eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define the features and their corresponding titles
features <- c("ARM_up_1", "ARM_down_1", "IRM_up_1", "CPM_up_1")
titles <- c("ARM *", "HM *", "IRM *", "CPM *")  # Custom titles

# Define custom breaks for each feature
custom_breaks <- list(
  ARM_up_1 = c(0.5, 1.2),    # Example: min, mid, max values for "ARM_up_1"
  ARM_down_1 = c(0.5,1.0),  # Example: min, mid, max values for "ARM_down_1"
  IRM_up_1 = c(0.25, 0.75),   # Example: min, mid, max values for "IRM_up_1"
  CPM_up_1 = c(0.08, 0.18)   # Example: min, mid, max values for "CPM_up_1"
)


# Loop over each feature to create the plots
for (i in seq_along(features)) {
  feature <- features[i]  # Get the current feature
  plot_title <- titles[i]  # Get the corresponding custom title
  
  # Get custom breaks and labels for the current feature
  breaks <- custom_breaks[[feature]]
  labels <- custom_breaks[[feature]]

  # Create the plot
  plots[[paste0(feature, "_feature")]] <- FeaturePlot(
    seurat_mg,
    features = feature,
    min.cutoff = "q10",
    max.cutoff = "q90",
    reduction = "umap.cca_rm", 
    pt.size = 0.1
  ) +
    ggtitle(plot_title) + 
    theme_umap +
    remove_axes+
    remove_grid +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",             
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6),  
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),   
     legend.margin = margin(t = -10),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 4, 0),
      legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm")
    ) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      name = "Average \nexpression",          
      colors = c("#c6daeb", "#3A0956"),
      breaks = breaks,                        # Use manually set breaks
      labels = labels                         # Use manually set labels
    )
}
plots[["feature"]] <- plots[["ARM_down_1_feature"]] + plots[["ARM_up_1_feature"]] +  plots[["IRM_up_1_feature"]] + plots[["CPM_up_1_feature"]] 
plots[["feature"]]
```

# Violin plots showing the expression of marker genes from Frigerio et al. (2019) in our dataset
```{r Violin_plots,  eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define the features for which you want to create violin plots
features <- c("ARM_up_1", "ARM_down_1", "IRM_up_1", "CPM_up_1")
titles <- c(
  "ARM *", 
  "HM *", 
  "IRM *", 
  "CPM *"
)

# Define your comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  "ARM_up_1" = list(c("HM1", "ARM"), c("HM2", "ARM") ),
  "ARM_down_1" = list(c("HM1", "ARM"), c("HM2", "ARM")),
  "IRM_up_1" = list(c("HM1", "IRM"), c("HM2", "IRM")),
  "CPM_up_1" = list(c("HM1", "CPM"), c("HM2", "CPM"))
)
# Loop over each feature to create the plots
for (i in seq_along(features)) {
  feature <- features[i]  # Get the current feature
  plot_title <- titles[i]
  feature_comparisons <- comparisons[[feature]]  # Get the comparisons for the current feature
  
  # Calculate the maximum y-value in the data for scaling
  max_y <- max(seurat_mg@meta.data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Define custom label.y values for each comparison
  label_y_positions <- c(
    0.8 * max_y,  # For the first comparison
    0.9* max_y   # For the second comparison
  )
  
  # Create the plot
  plots[[paste0(feature, "_violin")]] <- VlnPlot(
    seurat_mg,
    features = feature,
    group.by = "Cell_types_mg_abbr",
    pt.size = 0.0,  # Adjust this value if needed
    cols = col_list[["UMAP_mg"]]
  ) +
    ggtitle(plot_title) + 
    theme_mk_title +
    remove_grid +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 290, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5), 
      legend.position = "bottom",             
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6),  
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),   
      legend.margin = margin(t = -10),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 2, 0),
      axis.title.x = element_blank()          
    ) +
    NoLegend() +
    # Overlay box plot with white fill
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", fill = "white") +
    labs(y = if (i == 2) "Average expression" else NULL) +
    # Add statistical comparison with adjusted spacing
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = feature_comparisons,                     # Use the comparisons specific to this feature
      method = "wilcox.test",                                # Wilcoxon test
      label = "p.signif",                                    # Display significance
      method.args = list(paired = FALSE),                   # Specify unpaired test
      hide.ns = FALSE,                                      # Display non-significant results
      label.x.npc = "left",                                # Position labels horizontally
      label.y = label_y_positions,                          # Use custom label.y positions
      vjust = 0.5                                        # Adjust the vertical position of asterisks
    )
}

# Combine the plots (example)
plots[["violin"]] <- plots[["ARM_down_1_violin"]] + plots[["ARM_up_1_violin"]] +
  plots[["IRM_up_1_violin"]] + plots[["CPM_up_1_violin"]]
plots[["violin"]]
```

# Garcia-Bonilla markers
```{r}
#Load seurat
seurat_mg <- readRDS("ws/1DP_01_seurat_merged_integrated_UMAP_mg_cells.rds")
DefaultAssay(seurat_mg) <- "RNA" 
seurat_mg <- JoinLayers(seurat_mg, assay = "RNA")
all.genes.RNA <- rownames(seurat_mg)
seurat_mg <- NormalizeData(seurat_mg, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
seurat_mg <- ScaleData(seurat_mg, features = all.genes.RNA)
# 1. Create a master list of all Mg gene sets (converting Symbols to ENSEMBL)
mg_signatures <- list(
  Mg1 = Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(c("Rn7sk", "Siglech", "P2ry12", "Maf", "Ivns1abp", "Tgfbr1", "Nrip1", "Zfhx3", "Crybb1", "Sult1a1")),
  Mg2 = Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(c("Jun", "Klf2", "Btg2", "Klf4", "Klf6", "Cited2", "Dusp1", "Dnajb1", "Ubc", "Zfp36")),
  Mg3 = Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(c("Apoe", "Cst7", "Clec7a", "Ifi27l2a", "Lyz2", "Lgals3bp", "Igf1", "H2-D1", "Lpl", "Apoc1")),
  Mg4 = Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(c("Spp1", "Lgals3", "Msr1", "Lgals1", "Ccl12", "Dab2", "Plin2", "Cstb", "Pkm", "Lilr4b")),
  Mg5 = Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(c("Top2a", "Mki67", "Birc5", "Smc4", "Pclaf", "Tubb5", "Stmn1", "Prc1", "Ube2c", "Hmmr")),
  Mg6 = Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(c("Il1b", "Cd83", "Nfkbiz", "Ccl4", "Egr1", "Atf3", "Adams1", "Ccl3", "Fos", "Fosb")),
  Mg7 = Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(c("Gpnmb", "Chst1", "Axl", "Itgax", "Ly9", "Ctla2a", "Ctsa", "Cox6a2", "Gramd1b", "Lipa")),
  Mg8 = Symbol_to_ENSEMBL(c("Srm", "Lsm5", "Clec4a3", "Sp3os", "Tpt1", "Ndufab1", "Snrpd2", "Nop10", "Ms4a6b", "Cox7b"))
)

# 2. Set the default assay to RNA (since you previously preferred this)
DefaultAssay(seurat_mg) <- "RNA"

# 3. Loop through the list to calculate each Module Score
for (mg_name in names(mg_signatures)) {
  
  message("Calculating score for: ", mg_name)
  
  # Ensure we only use genes present in the object to avoid errors
  valid_genes <- intersect(mg_signatures[[mg_name]], rownames(seurat_mg))
  
  if (length(valid_genes) > 0) {
    seurat_mg <- AddModuleScore(
      object = seurat_mg,
      features = list(valid_genes),
      assay = "RNA",
      name = paste0(mg_name, "_up_") # This creates columns like Mg1_up_1, Mg2_up_1, etc.
    )
  } else {
    message("Warning: No matching genes found for ", mg_name)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# 1. Define the 8 features and custom titles
features <- paste0("Mg", 1:8, "_up_1")
titles <- paste0("Mg", 1:8, " *")

# 2. Define custom breaks (adjust these based on your data ranges)
# Note: If you're unsure of the ranges, run: summary(seurat_mg@meta.data[, features])
custom_breaks <- list(
  Mg1_up_1 = c(0.5, 1.0),
  Mg2_up_1 = c(0.1, 0.3),
  Mg3_up_1 = c(0.3, 1.0),
  Mg4_up_1 = c(0.2, 0.5),
  Mg5_up_1 = c(0.1, 0.25),
  Mg6_up_1 = c(0.1, 0.3),
  Mg7_up_1 = c(0.1, 0.4),
  Mg8_up_1 = c(0.1, 0.4)
)

# Initialize plot list
plots_umap <- list()

# 3. Loop over features to create UMAPs
for (i in seq_along(features)) {
  feature <- features[i]
  plot_title <- titles[i]
  
  # Get breaks for current feature
  breaks <- custom_breaks[[feature]]
  
  plots_umap[[feature]] <- FeaturePlot(
    seurat_mg,
    features = feature,
    min.cutoff = "q10",
    max.cutoff = "q90",
    reduction = "umap.cca_rm", 
    pt.size = 0.1
  ) +
    ggtitle(plot_title) + 
    theme_umap +
    remove_axes+
    remove_grid +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",             
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6),  
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),   
     legend.margin = margin(t = -10),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 4, 0),
      legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm")
    ) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      name = "Average \nexpression",          
      colors = c("#c6daeb", "#3A0956"),
      breaks = breaks,                        # Use manually set breaks
      #labels = labels                         # Use manually set labels
    )
}

# 4. Combine all 8 into a publication-ready grid
library(patchwork)
plots_umap[["Mg_all_UMAP"]] <- wrap_plots(plots_umap[features], ncol = 4)
# Add theme adjustment to the combined object
# margin(t, r, b, l) -> top, right, bottom, left
plots_umap[["Mg_all_UMAP"]] <- plots_umap[["Mg_all_UMAP"]] & 
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b =25, l = 5))
plots_umap[["Mg_all_UMAP"]]
```
